name: Eruption
description: Sets a tile up to %cast_range% tiles away ablaze for %duration% turns, immediately applying %burn_stacks_init% stacks of Burn to whoever is standing on it.
details: Any enemy that ends its turn in the flames gains another %burn_stacks% stack.
Ground that is already alight can be lit again, which refreshes how long it burns for.

upgrade.summary: Sets %targets% tiles ablaze with a single cast.
upgrade.description: Sets %targets% tiles up to %cast_range% tiles away ablaze for %duration% turns, immediately applying %burn_stacks_init% stacks of Burn to whoever is standing on them.
details: Any enemy that ends its turn in the flames gains another %burn_stacks% stack.
Ground that is already alight can be lit again, which refreshes how long it burns for.
The %targets% tiles are picked independently - burning ground already alight simply to keep it lit is a fair use of one of them.
